description.text:
The deck that won the Masters Division of the 2011 World Championships, beating The Truth in the final. Emboar powers up both Reshiram and Magnezone's Lost Burn, Twins and Cleffa find the cards it needs, and Rayquaza & Deoxys LEGEND can surprise the opponent and take two Prize cards. The 2011 World Championships were held at the Hilton San Diego Bayfront in San Diego, California, from 12 to 14 August 2011, with more than 400 card and video game players from over 27 countries.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2011 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet and a deck box. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
